definitions.rationale: This nullary equation defines the named proof term solutionModule() as the exact translated Module constructor tree; it does not replace or accelerate execution of the function body.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule()
    => Module(
         FuncDef("compare_one", Params("a", "b"),
           If(Call(Name("isinstance"), Name("a"), Name("str")),
             Assign(Name("a_value"),
               Call(Name("float"),
                 Call(Attribute(Name("a"), "replace"), Str(","), Str(".")))) .Stmts,
             Assign(Name("a_value"), Name("a")) .Stmts)
           If(Call(Name("isinstance"), Name("b"), Name("str")),
             Assign(Name("b_value"),
               Call(Name("float"),
                 Call(Attribute(Name("b"), "replace"), Str(","), Str(".")))) .Stmts,
             Assign(Name("b_value"), Name("b")) .Stmts)
           If(Compare(Name("a_value"), CmpOp(">", Name("b_value"))),
             Return(Name("a")) .Stmts, .Stmts)
           If(Compare(Name("b_value"), CmpOp(">", Name("a_value"))),
             Return(Name("b")) .Stmts, .Stmts)
           Return(NoneVal) .Stmts))

definitions.rationale: This constructor equation defines numericValue on Int arguments as the identity mathematical summary.
This constructor equation defines numericValue on Float arguments as the identity mathematical summary.
This constructor equation defines the modeled numeric value of a string as comma-to-dot replacement followed by the supplied decStrToF summary.
This guarded equation defines the first case of expectedCompare, selecting the original first argument when its summarized numeric value is greater.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompare(A:Val, B:Val) => A
    requires applyCmp(">", numericValue(A), numericValue(B))

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines the second disjoint case of expectedCompare, selecting the original second argument when only the reverse greater-than test holds.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompare(A:Val, B:Val) => B
    requires notBool applyCmp(">", numericValue(A), numericValue(B))
     andBool applyCmp(">", numericValue(B), numericValue(A))

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines the remaining expectedCompare case as noneV when neither summarized numeric value is greater.
definitions.text:
rule expectedCompare(A:Val, B:Val) => noneV
    requires notBool applyCmp(">", numericValue(A), numericValue(B))
     andBool notBool applyCmp(">", numericValue(B), numericValue(A))
